app.name: Money Tracker
app.updatingBody: Close Money Tracker in any other tab or window, then it will continue by itself.

home.emptyNone: Nothing here yet. Tap + to add your first expense or income.
home.emptyMonth: No Transactions this month. Tap + to add one.
home.emptySummary: Add a Transaction to see this month's summary.

summary.overlap: Categories overlap: a Transaction counts in each of its Categories, so these lines add up to more than the real total above.

photos.title: Receipts
photos.unreadable: That photo could not be read.

report.title: Report
report.failed: The report could not be saved. Please try again.
report.heading: Monthly report: {{month}}

form.retiredHint: Retired label. Tap to remove it.
form.saveFailedBody: This change could not be saved on this device. Back up your data now so you don't lose it.

categories.title: Categories
categories.name: Name
categories.deleteInfo_one: {{count}} Transaction uses this Category. Its name stays on it as a retired label.
categories.deleteInfo_other: {{count}} Transactions use this Category. Its name stays on them as a retired label.

errors.duplicate: Another Category already has this name.
errors.reserved: This name belongs to a deleted Category that is still on some Transactions.

settings.exportZipHelp: One file with Transactions, Categories, recurring rules, settings and receipt photos.
settings.title: Settings
settings.openingBalanceHelp: What you already had before recording Transactions. It can be negative.
settings.exportHelp: Saves two CSV files: Transactions and Categories. Keep them somewhere outside the browser.
settings.importHelp: Replaces everything with the two CSV files from a backup.
settings.openingNote: The opening balance and the language are not stored in the backup files.
settings.storageProtectedHelp: The browser promised not to erase this app's data on its own.
settings.storageNotGuaranteedHelp: The browser may erase this app's data. Back up regularly.
settings.installIos: In Safari tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
settings.eraseHelp: Deletes every Transaction, Category and setting from this device.
settings.eraseBody: Everything on this device will be deleted and this cannot be undone. Export a backup first if you might want it back.
settings.privacy: Your data stays on this device.
settings.recurringHelp: Rent, salary, subscriptions and other Transactions that repeat.

banner.backupNever: You have not backed up yet.
banner.installBody: Data in a browser tab can be erased after 7 days of inactivity. Tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.

firstRun.tagline: A simple tracker for your money. Your data stays on this device.
firstRun.startingHelp: Optional: how much money you have right now. You can change it later in Settings.

zip.notAnArchive: That file is not a ZIP backup.
zip.missingFile: That ZIP does not contain a Transactions file and a Categories file.

import.title: Import a backup
import.chooseHelp: Select the Transactions and Categories files together. A Recurring file is optional.
import.needBoth: Select both files: one with Transactions and one with Categories.
import.unreadable: A file could not be read.
import.rowsToImport: {{transactions}} Transactions and {{categories}} Categories will replace everything on this device.
import.exportFirst: This cannot be merged. Export a backup of your current data first if you want to keep it.

reasons.invalidDate: date is not a valid YYYY-MM-DD date
reasons.invalidType: type must be expense or income
reasons.invalidAmount: amount must be above zero with at most 2 decimals
reasons.invalidFrequency: frequency must be weekly, monthly or yearly
reasons.invalidDateRange: the end date is before the start date

fatal.transactionsColumns: The Transactions file does not have the expected columns (date, type, amount, categories, note).
fatal.categoriesColumns: The Categories file does not have the expected columns (type, name, default_key).
fatal.recurringColumns: The Recurring file does not have the expected columns (type, amount, categories, note, frequency, start_date, end_date, next_date).

import.openingCheckBody: The opening balance is not stored in the backup files, so please check it.
import.rulesToImport_one: {{count}} recurring rule will also be restored.
import.rulesToImport_other: {{count}} recurring rules will also be restored.

export.zipDone: Backup saved. Keep the ZIP somewhere outside the browser.
export.done: Backup saved. Keep the files somewhere outside the browser.

recurring.title: Recurring
recurring.empty: No recurring Transactions yet. Turn on Repeat when you add one.
recurring.stopBody: No more Transactions will be created. The ones already created are kept.
recurring.ruleHelp: Changes apply to future Transactions only.

drive.title: Google Drive
drive.connectHelp: Saves your full backup to a hidden folder in your own Google Drive, automatically after each change. The app cannot see your other files.
drive.autoHelp: Connected. Changes are saved to Drive automatically.
drive.expiredHelp: Google asks you to sign in again every hour. Automatic saving is paused until you do.
drive.conflict: Google Drive has a newer backup from another device. Automatic saving is paused.
drive.conflictToast: Google Drive has a newer backup from another device. Check Settings.
drive.failed: Google Drive could not be reached. Try again later.
drive.expiredToast: Google Drive needs you to sign in again.
drive.nothingToRestore: There is no backup in Google Drive yet.
drive.disconnected: Google Drive disconnected. The backup stays in your Drive.
drive.loadedNewer: Loaded the latest data from Google Drive
drive.loadedAdded_one: 1 new Transaction loaded from Google Drive
drive.loadedAdded_other: {{count}} new Transactions loaded from Google Drive
drive.loadedRemoved_one: 1 Transaction removed on your other device
drive.loadedRemoved_other: {{count}} Transactions removed on your other device
drive.loadedBoth: Loaded from Google Drive: {{added}} new or changed, {{removed}} removed
